title: Greek Salad with Anchovy Topping
description: A classic Greek salad with the addition of salty anchovy for added depth. Perfect for a keto diet.

ingredients.name: Greek Salad Mix
ingredients.notes: pre-washed, pre-cut mix of lettuce, tomato, cucumber, red onion

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the Greek salad mix, sliced onion, and crumbled feta cheese.
2. Drizzle olive oil and red wine vinegar over the salad, tossing to combine.
3. Top the salad with anchovy fillets, breaking them up slightly with a fork.
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
5. Garnish with additional sliced onion, if desired.
6. Serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to 2 hours before serving.
